title: Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels), Cadet or Graduate level
location: Civic Centre, 243 Baylis Street, Wagga Wagga NSW 2650
content_text: Wagga Wagga City Council, Engineering Design Services. Permanent full-time (35 hours). This position may be filled at Cadet, Graduate, Experienced or Senior Engineer level depending on the successful applicant's qualifications, skills and experience. As a Cadet or Graduate Civil Design Engineer you will assist senior staff in the delivery of complex road, stormwater and sewer designs suitable for tender and construction and develop your engineering skillset through learning opportunities. Applicants shall be able to demonstrate: an understanding of key engineering design principles and procedures; a clear willingness to learn and develop technical skillsets; solid time management, organisational, financial and administrative skills, with sound computer literacy; strong communication and interpersonal skills. Core design software named for senior level: 12d Model, Civil3D and AutoCAD. As the successful applicant you will have: tertiary qualifications (or currently undertaking) in Civil Engineering; registration or suitability for immediate registration (CPEng or NER) for Senior Civil Design Engineer applicants only; Class C Driver's Licence (or ability to obtain); General Construction Induction Training Card (White) (or willingness to obtain). Applications close Sunday 1 November 2026 at 11.59pm with interviews the week commencing Monday 9 November 2026. Enquiries: Geordi Paxton, Manager Engineering Design Services, 02 6926 9422. Police check consent for selected candidates. Apply via https://wagga.pulsesoftware.com/Pulse/jobs. Full advert text read via Jobstralia mirror https://www.jobstralia.com/detail/8/53d32c885e2201795362c4a3cb83cdb7; listing, closing date and department confirmed live on the Pulse board 13 Oct 2026.
apply_instructions: Apply on Council's Pulse portal (https://wagga.pulsesoftware.com/Pulse/jobs, card 'Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels)', closes 1 Nov 2026 11:59pm). No application email published; Geordi Paxton is a phone enquiry contact only.
